3-PARTY ALLIANCE

                                    Survey: Most LDP candidates open to coalition with DPP
                                                

February 2, 2026

Almost all candidates from the Liberal Democratic Party running in the Feb. 8 Lower House election are amenable to forming a coalition with the opposition Democratic Party for the People, according to a recent survey.

MUST TAKE AT PHARMACY

                                        Emergency contraception now available over the counter
                                                        

February 2, 2026

Aska Pharmaceutical Co.’s NorLevo morning-after pill became available over the counter at pharmacies and drugstores on Feb. 2, the first time emergency contraception has become accessible without a prescription in Japan. 

COULD GAIN A MAJORITY

                                        Survey: LDP may ride Takaichi’s popularity to big Lower House win
                                                        

February 2, 2026

The ruling Liberal Democratic Party is on track to significantly gain more than the 233 seats needed for a majority on its own in the Feb. 8 Lower House election, according to a new Asahi Shimbun survey.
